youtube.title: Did a shot start on the wrong frame? New in funkbox: frame review, every shot on one sheet
youtube.description:
Did a shot start on the wrong frame? New in funkbox: frame review.
`funkbox reel review` writes one sheet with the first and last frame of every shot. Here it is on the GLOWMOP demo ad: shot s3 opens with its caption mid-reveal.
Every promo on this channel is checked by a second AI agent before it posts. This Short rendered in under 60 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
